prompt: Create a highly detailed isometric country diorama poster of France shaped exactly like the national map outline, floating on a clean off-white background with soft studio shadows. At the top, add centered typography: small spaced uppercase continent label “EUROPE”, a huge bold uppercase title “FRANCE” in dark charcoal, the national flag to the right of the title as three vertical stripes blue, white, red, and a smaller spaced subtitle “PARIS • 67.4 MILLION”. The map should be a miniature 3D terrain slab with vertical rocky cliff sides around the entire coastline and borders, showing lush green countryside, patchwork farmland, forests, rivers, highways, and tiny towns. Include exactly 9 major landmark/region features: 1 central Paris area with the Eiffel Tower rising prominently, 2 a Gothic cathedral landmark in the north, 3 a western Atlantic harbor with docks, sailboats, and a lighthouse, 4 a northern coastal city cluster, 5 a broad mountain range with snowy peaks along the southeast, 6 a smaller snowy mountain range along the southwest, 7 a Mediterranean bay with marina, sailboats, and coastal city at the south, 8 a river valley network crossing the center and east, and 9 the separate island of Corsica as a smaller rocky diorama piece floating to the lower right with miniature terrain and towns. Use realistic miniature-model detail, crisp isometric perspective from above, warm daylight, saturated natural greens and blues, shallow depth of field, polished travel-atlas infographic aesthetics, no border, no watermark, no extra labels beyond the title, flag, continent, and capital/population text.

promptZh: 创作一张干净的编辑风格海报，展示一个 法国 的等轴测 3D 国家立体模型，悬浮在米白色的摄影棚背景上。陆地形状精确还原法国本土，右下角设有一个独立的科西嘉岛小岛，渲染为带有垂直岩石悬崖边缘和柔和投影的厚实雕刻地形切片。地图上布满郁郁葱葱的绿色乡村、拼布般的黄色和棕褐色农田、森林、蜿蜒的蓝色河流、细窄的道路、微型城镇、港口、船只以及区域地标。将巴黎置于中心位置，以醒目的微型埃菲尔铁塔为焦点，并包含标志性的法国风光，包括东南部的阿尔卑斯雪山、西南部的比利牛斯风格雪山、底部的地中海海岸线和码头、左侧带有灯塔和小帆船的大西洋海岸线，以及散布在地图各处的教堂/城堡式地标。采用高度精细的微型模型写实风格、俯视等轴测视角、温暖的日光、清晰的景深、逼真的地形纹理以及精致的旅行地图美学。在顶部添加居中排版：小间距大写文本“EUROPE”，紧接着是一个非常大的粗体压缩大写标题“FRANCE”（深炭灰色），右侧紧跟一个由蓝、白、红三色等宽条纹组成的垂直三色旗。在标题下方，添加小间距大写元数据：“PARIS • 67.4 MILLION”。保持构图对称、高级且整洁，不要添加额外的标签、边框、水印或任何其他文字。
